note: A single shaded back-in dirt site for up to ten people on Butternut Hollow Road. The agency's route from US 6 takes Elk Run Road (SR 3001) 2.6 miles, turns right onto Leetonia Road for 7.6 miles, and continues straight onto Sliders Road for 1.1 miles and then Butternut Hollow Road for about 0.8 mile. The booking page sells it for RVs and trailers, while the DCNR campsite map layer marks it as having no trailer access. The agency cautions that it is reached by dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Stone fire ring; no table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
